items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: he wanted to know if I'd like to do some arrangements for Vincent Youmans

ctx.x: Leiderkrantz -- we finished up there and then it was shortly after that, it seemed to me, we made a few there, but maybe quite some time before we went over to Columbia, and made all the records at Columbia, and I think -- then we began to get into the Old Gold Show -- oh, going out to the coast, like the first time, I was working here in the city and I got a call one day from Fletcher, you know, he wanted to know if I'd like to do some arrangements for Vincent Youmans. Well, he said, his band was playing at ---…
